headline: Weathered Expanse Reignites With Rapid Base Transfers As Heavy Clashes Spread
war_summary: Base turnover has dramatically reignited across Weathered Expanse, logging six fresh strategic transfers in the past two hours as Spirit Watch and Wightwalk remain hotly contested amidst escalating casualties. Mooring County has also flared into motion, registering three base exchanges centered around The Wind Hills alongside a sharp rise in losses. Along the Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line sectors, relentless fighting endures; both fronts recorded multiple base transitions in the two-hour window while combined casualty rates surged past two thousand per hour in each theater. In contrast, the rapid territorial exchanges previously observed across Stonecradle have paused with zero base changes over the latest two hours, and the attritional drain in Callahan's Passage has cooled considerably. Elsewhere, Dead Lands exhibits accelerating casualty rates across contested ground without shifting base ownership, while rearward provinces remain completely quiet.
